{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward if sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment=0.00) and model overestimates recent price spikes.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is > 10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 5-10% to avoid over-optimism.",
    "Correct for lag: if true outcome is > 10% above forecast at day 1, assume model is lagging and adjust forward by 1-2% per day.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoot after sharp spikes: if model forecast > true outcome by > 15% and sentiment is neutral, apply 15% downward correction.",
